fullDescription:
Tamil Nadu has one of the deepest manufacturing bases in the country, with strength in automotive components, textiles, leather and electronics.

The state council meets every quarter and runs four working groups. Its skills programme places trainees with member companies across Chennai, Coimbatore and Hosur, and its export clinic has helped members reach first orders in eleven new markets.

The council’s representations to the state government cover power tariffs, land allotment, MSME credit and clearances.

shortDescription: Tamil Nadu lies in the southernmost part of the Indian Peninsula and is bordered by the union territory of Puducherry and the states of Kerala, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. It is bounded by the Eastern Ghats on the north, the Nilgiri and Anamalai Hills and Kerala on the west, the Bay of Bengal in the east, and the Gulf of Mannar and the Palk Strait on the south-east. It is the second largest economy and one of the fastest growing states in India.

events.title: Andaman and Nicobar Islands Industry Conclave 2026
events.summary: A full day on capacity, costs and the state's fisheries supply chain.
events.body: Sessions on fisheries and timber & coir, energy costs and logistics, with a buyer-seller meet in the afternoon. Open to member companies and to two delegates from each district chapter.

events.title: Export Readiness Clinic — Mayabunder
events.summary: One-to-one clinics on documentation, incoterms and first-order pricing.
events.body: Members bring a live enquiry and leave with a costed quotation, the documentation checklist for their product line, and an introduction to a freight forwarder on the panel.

events.title: MSME Credit Mela with Lead Banks
events.summary: Bankers, guarantee schemes and members, in one room for a day.
events.body: Six banks and the guarantee corporation take applications on the spot. Members are asked to bring two years of returns and a one-page project note.

events.title: Skills Programme — Port Blair Placement Day
events.summary: Interviews for the current batches, with member companies on the panel.
events.body: Candidates come from the batches run with the Andaman and Nicobar Islands skill mission. Member companies interview on the day and offers are made the same week.

events.title: Women in Enterprise — Port Blair Chapter
events.summary: A market-access clinic for women-led member companies.

hero.headline: Andhra Pradesh
hero.tagline: A long coast, a working port and an industry base that ships.
hero.blurb: Andhra Pradesh runs along the Coromandel Coast between Odisha and Tamil Nadu, with the Eastern Ghats behind a coastline of almost a thousand kilometres — the second longest of any Indian state. Its industry is built on that coast: the ports at Visakhapatnam, Krishnapatnam and Kakinada, pharmaceuticals and aquaculture around the Krishna and Godavari deltas, and automotive and textile clusters inland.

events.title: Karnataka Industry Conclave 2026
events.summary: A full day on capacity, costs and the state's electronics & it hardware supply chain.
events.body: Sessions on electronics & it hardware and machine tools, energy costs and logistics, with a buyer-seller meet in the afternoon. Open to member companies and to two delegates from each district chapter.

events.title: Export Readiness Clinic — Mysuru
events.summary: One-to-one clinics on documentation, incoterms and first-order pricing.
events.body: Members bring a live enquiry and leave with a costed quotation, the documentation checklist for their product line, and an introduction to a freight forwarder on the panel.

events.title: MSME Credit Mela with Lead Banks
events.summary: Bankers, guarantee schemes and members, in one room for a day.
events.body: Six banks and the guarantee corporation take applications on the spot. Members are asked to bring two years of returns and a one-page project note.

events.title: Skills Programme — Bengaluru Placement Day
events.summary: Interviews for the current batches, with member companies on the panel.
events.body: Candidates come from the batches run with the Karnataka skill mission. Member companies interview on the day and offers are made the same week.

events.title: Women in Enterprise — Bengaluru Chapter
events.summary: A market-access clinic for women-led member companies.
events.body: Buyers from retail chains and e-commerce platforms take introductions. Twenty places, allotted by the chapter committee.

events.title: Electronics & IT Hardware Sector Roundtable
events.summary: What the electronics & it hardware members are asking the state for, worked through with numbers.
events.body: The council's submission is explained clause by clause, followed by the costed examples behind it. Member companies may add to the submission on the day.

events.title: Annual General Meeting and Awards Night
events.summary: The year's accounts, the council elections and the member awards.
events.body: The AGM is followed by the awards dinner. Nominations for the member awards close six weeks before the date and are judged by the outgoing council.

fullDescription:
Karnataka is built on electronics & it hardware, machine tools and aerospace & defence, with member companies in Bengaluru, Mysuru, Hubballi and the districts around them.

The council meets every quarter and runs four working groups. Its skills programme places trainees with member companies across Bengaluru and Mysuru, and its export desk has taken members from a first enquiry to a first shipment in new markets.

The council's representations to the government cover power tariffs, land allotment, electronics & it hardware incentives and MSME credit.

hero.headline: Karnataka
hero.tagline: Machine tools, aerospace and the country’s deepest technology base.
hero.blurb: Karnataka spans the Deccan plateau, the Western Ghats and a short Arabian Sea coast, and holds the largest concentration of technology and aerospace employers in the country. Beyond Bengaluru it is an industrial state of long standing — steel at Ballari, machine tools and engineering at Mysuru and Belagavi, and the cotton and sugar belt of the north.

shortDescription: Karnataka sits on the Deccan plateau with a short western coast, bordered by Maharashtra, Goa, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Kerala. It holds the country’s largest concentration of electronics, aerospace and machine-tool capacity, and a garment industry that employs several hundred thousand people around Bengaluru and Mysuru.

vision.title: Our vision for Karnataka
vision.text: A Karnataka where a small unit can grow into a mid-sized one — with the skills, the credit and the market access to do it — and where the council is the first place a member turns when something stands in the way.

fullDescription:
Kerala is built on spices & marine exports, rubber & plantations and light engineering, with member companies in Kochi, Kozhikode, Thrissur and the districts around them.

The council meets every quarter and runs four working groups. Its skills programme places trainees with member companies across Kochi and Kozhikode, and its export desk has taken members from a first enquiry to a first shipment in new markets.

The council's representations to the government cover power tariffs, land allotment, spices & marine exports incentives and MSME credit.

hero.headline: Kerala
hero.tagline: Spices, marine exports and the most skilled workforce in the South.
hero.blurb: Kerala is a narrow strip between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea, the most densely settled and the most literate of the southern states. Its economy turns on the plantation crops of the hills, the marine and spice trade of the coast, a shipbuilding and refining cluster at Kochi, and remittances from a large workforce abroad.

shortDescription: Kerala lies between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea, bordered by Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, with a coastline of five hundred and ninety kilometres. It is the country’s leading exporter of spices and one of its largest in marine products, and it has the highest literacy rate in India — which is what its light-engineering and services base is built on. Kochi handles container and cruise traffic on the west coast, and the plantation districts of Idukki and Wayanad supply the spice and rubber trades that most of the council’s exporting members work in.

vision.title: Our vision for Kerala
vision.text: A Kerala where a small unit can grow into a mid-sized one — with the skills, the credit and the market access to do it — and where the council is the first place a member turns when something stands in the way.

shortDescription: Lakshadweep is an archipelago of thirty-six islands in the Arabian Sea, ten of them inhabited, lying two hundred to four hundred kilometres off the coast of Kerala. Its economy is tuna fishing, coconut and coir, and a small, carefully limited tourism trade. Nearly every enterprise on the islands is a household or a cooperative, and freight to the mainland runs through Kochi and Beypore. The council’s work here is about market access, cold-chain capacity and the cost of moving goods off the islands.

vision.title: Our vision for Lakshadweep
vision.text: A Lakshadweep where a small unit can grow into a mid-sized one — with the skills, the credit and the market access to do it — and where the council is the first place a member turns when something stands in the way.

events.title: Puducherry Industry Conclave 2026
events.summary: A full day on capacity, costs and the state's light manufacturing supply chain.
events.body: Sessions on light manufacturing and pharmaceuticals, energy costs and logistics, with a buyer-seller meet in the afternoon. Open to member companies and to two delegates from each district chapter.

events.title: Export Readiness Clinic — Karaikal
events.summary: One-to-one clinics on documentation, incoterms and first-order pricing.
events.body: Members bring a live enquiry and leave with a costed quotation, the documentation checklist for their product line, and an introduction to a freight forwarder on the panel.

events.title: MSME Credit Mela with Lead Banks
events.summary: Bankers, guarantee schemes and members, in one room for a day.
events.body: Six banks and the guarantee corporation take applications on the spot. Members are asked to bring two years of returns and a one-page project note.

events.title: Skills Programme — Puducherry Placement Day
events.summary: Interviews for the current batches, with member companies on the panel.
events.body: Candidates come from the batches run with the Puducherry skill mission. Member companies interview on the day and offers are made the same week.

events.title: Women in Enterprise — Puducherry Chapter
events.summary: A market-access clinic for women-led member companies.
events.body: Buyers from retail chains and e-commerce platforms take introductions. Twenty places, allotted by the chapter committee.

events.title: Light Manufacturing Sector Roundtable
events.summary: What the light manufacturing members are asking the state for, worked through with numbers.
events.body: The council's submission is explained clause by clause, followed by the costed examples behind it. Member companies may add to the submission on the day.

events.title: Annual General Meeting and Awards Night
events.summary: The year's accounts, the council elections and the member awards.
events.body: The AGM is followed by the awards dinner. Nominations for the member awards close six weeks before the date and are judged by the outgoing council.

fullDescription:
Puducherry is built on light manufacturing, pharmaceuticals and textiles, with member companies in Puducherry, Karaikal, Yanam and the districts around them.

The council meets every quarter and runs four working groups. Its skills programme places trainees with member companies across Puducherry and Karaikal, and its export desk has taken members from a first enquiry to a first shipment in new markets.

The council's representations to the government cover power tariffs, land allotment, light manufacturing incentives and MSME credit.

hero.headline: Puducherry
hero.tagline: Four districts, one industrial base, and a coast that trades.
hero.blurb: Puducherry is four separate enclaves on two coasts — Puducherry and Karaikal on the Bay of Bengal, Yanam in the Godavari delta and Mahe on the Arabian Sea — and was French India until 1954. Its small industrial base is concentrated in pharmaceuticals, automotive components, textiles and tourism.

shortDescription: Puducherry is a union territory of four districts — Puducherry and Karaikal on the Coromandel coast, Yanam on the Godavari delta and Mahé on the Malabar coast. Its industry is light manufacturing, pharmaceuticals and textiles, and its proximity to Chennai puts its units inside an established supply chain. The territory’s industrial estates hold a mix of automotive components, formulations and garment units, most of them small and medium enterprises, and tourism carries a significant part of the local economy through the year.

vision.title: Our vision for Puducherry
vision.text: A Puducherry where a small unit can grow into a mid-sized one — with the skills, the credit and the market access to do it — and where the council is the first place a member turns when something stands in the way.

events.summary: A full day on capacity, costs and the state's pharma & life sciences supply chain.
events.body: Sessions on pharma & life sciences and technology services, energy costs and logistics, with a buyer-seller meet in the afternoon. Open to member companies and to two delegates from each district chapter.

events.summary: One-to-one clinics on documentation, incoterms and first-order pricing.
events.body: Members bring a live enquiry and leave with a costed quotation, the documentation checklist for their product line, and an introduction to a freight forwarder on the panel.

events.summary: Bankers, guarantee schemes and members, in one room for a day.
events.body: Six banks and the guarantee corporation take applications on the spot. Members are asked to bring two years of returns and a one-page project note.

events.summary: Interviews for the current batches, with member companies on the panel.
events.body: Candidates come from the batches run with the Telangana skill mission. Member companies interview on the day and offers are made the same week.

events.summary: A market-access clinic for women-led member companies.
events.body: Buyers from retail chains and e-commerce platforms take introductions. Twenty places, allotted by the chapter committee.

events.title: Pharma & Life Sciences Sector Roundtable
events.summary: What the pharma & life sciences members are asking the state for, worked through with numbers.
events.body: The council's submission is explained clause by clause, followed by the costed examples behind it. Member companies may add to the submission on the day.

events.title: Annual General Meeting and Awards Night
events.summary: The year's accounts, the council elections and the member awards.
events.body: The AGM is followed by the awards dinner. Nominations for the member awards close six weeks before the date and are judged by the outgoing council.

fullDescription:
Telangana is built on pharma & life sciences, technology services and textiles, with member companies in Hyderabad, Warangal, Nizamabad and the districts around them.

The council meets every quarter and runs four working groups. Its skills programme places trainees with member companies across Hyderabad and Warangal, and its export desk has taken members from a first enquiry to a first shipment in new markets.

The council's representations to the government cover power tariffs, land allotment, pharma & life sciences incentives and MSME credit.

hero.headline: Telangana
hero.tagline: Life sciences, technology services and a state that plans its corridors.
hero.blurb: Telangana sits on the Deccan plateau between the Godavari and the Krishna, and became a state in its own right in 2014. Hyderabad anchors it — pharmaceuticals and vaccines, information technology and defence electronics — while the districts carry cotton, rice, granite and a growing textile park at Warangal.

shortDescription: Telangana sits on the Deccan plateau, bordered by Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka. Hyderabad carries one of the largest life-sciences clusters in the world, and the state’s industrial corridors have drawn pharmaceutical, electronics and food-processing investment at scale. The corridor along the outer ring road and the parks at Warangal and Nizamabad have taken most of the new capacity, and the council’s members are concentrated in bulk drugs, engineering and textiles.

vision.title: Our vision for Telangana
vision.text: A Telangana where a small unit can grow into a mid-sized one — with the skills, the credit and the market access to do it — and where the council is the first place a member turns when something stands in the way.
